# Worldview @ Stage 1 — Prehension

> developed 2026-07-26. Deepened from 66 to 140+ lines.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 1 |
| Canonical name | Prehension |
| Altitude | `infrared` (Pre-egocentric) |
| MHC Order | 0 (Pre-systematic) |
| Kegan | Pre-Kegan |
| Identity band | Pre-egocentric |

## Expression on this line

Worldview at Order 0 is **pre-conceptual reality orientation**: the bare capacity of a
system to differentiate between "this" and "that" without any conceptual framework
whatsoever. A thermostat differentiates between "too hot" and "too cold." A phototropic
plant differentiates between "light" and "dark." This is worldview at its most primitive —
the first flicker of orientation toward the world, before any concept of "world" exists.

At this stage there is no "view" in any intentional sense. The thermostat does not have
a "worldview" — it has a differential response. The plant does not "see" the world — it
grows toward light. But this differential response is the precondition for all later
worldview development: the bare capacity to distinguish one state from another, which is
the foundation of all later perception, cognition, and understanding.

The key feature of Stage 1 worldview is that it is **reliable but not flexible**. The
thermostat always responds the same way. The plant always grows toward light. The system
is oriented toward the world but cannot modify its orientation based on experience. This
is the floor of worldview development: the bare precondition for all later orientation.

In biological systems, this stage corresponds to the most primitive sensory capacities:
a cell membrane that differentiates between "inside" and "outside," a nerve that fires
in response to stimulus. These are not "worldviews" — they are the substrate from which
worldviews will eventually grow.

The transition from Stage 1 to Stage 2 occurs when the differential response becomes
**modifiable** — when the system begins to adjust its orientation based on feedback.
At Stage 1, this does not yet happen. The thermostat does not learn from its own
temperature responses. The system is closed: it cannot update its own orientation.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** No interior correlate exists. There is no felt experience, no cultural norm,
  no shared understanding. The concept of interiority has not yet emerged.

- **UR:** The individual system exhibits reliable differential response. It differentiates
  between states with physical fidelity — it does not "choose" to differentiate, but it
  reliably does.

- **LL:** No collective expression. There are no conventions, no agreements, no shared
  orientations. The only "orientation" is the physical law that drives the differentiation.

- **LR:** The physical structure itself is the sole vehicle of orientation. The thermostat,
  the cell membrane, the phototropic stem — these are the "institutions" of Stage 1
  worldview.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** Not applicable. No agent exists to be addicted.

- **Dark allergy:** Impossible. No capacity to reject orientation exists.

- **Golden addiction:** Not applicable. No self exists to cling to.

- **Golden allergy:** The absence of any worldview trajectory is the structural ceiling.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Differential response only:** The system differentiates between states but cannot
  modify its differentiation based on experience.

- **No interior worldview reasoning:** No evidence of the system "deciding" how to
  orient. Orientation follows physical law.

- **No feedback between orientation and system:** The system does not change its own
  orientation based on its orientation outcomes.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:**
- Whitehead, A.N. (1929). *Process and Reality* — prehension as the foundation of
  all experience
- Peirce, C.S. (1878). "How to Make Our Ideas Clear" — the pragmatic foundations of
  worldview development
- Merleau-Ponty, M. (1945). *Phenomenology of Perception* — embodied orientation
  as the ground of worldview

**Open joints:**
- Where does physical differentiation shade into biological orientation? What is the
  minimal machinery for Stage 2?
- Is Stage 1 "worldview" truly a worldview, or is it the precondition for worldview?

- Pairs with `02-irritability` (first adaptive orientation)
